name: Measure AA Community Grants Program
summary: Rolling grants of up to $300,000 for community-based organisations in economically disadvantaged communities to plan or carry out small shoreline habitat projects around San Francisco Bay, with a shorter application and staff support.

steps: Email the initial Community Grants application
Submit the revised application for final review

eligibility.rule: Applicant is based in an economically disadvantaged community
Flood management or public access must be part of a habitat project

status.quote: We are accepting and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

applicant_types.quote: Community-based organizations in EDCs are eligible to apply for Community Grants.

geography.quote: A habitat project that aims to restore, protect, or enhance tidal wetlands, managed ponds, or natural habitats on the shoreline in the San Francisco Bay Area

access.quote: It provides an alternative pathway for community-based organizations in economically disadvantaged communities to getting a grant

window.quote: You can apply at any time. We are accepting and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: The maximum amount that the Authority will provide for a Community Grant is $300,000.

effort.quote: Please submit an application to grants@sfbayrestore.org.
Staff will schedule a consultation with you to talk through the project, and a review team will assess whether the project is a good fit for the Community Grants Program.
Initial and revised applications accepted on rolling basis
If it is, staff will work closely with you to develop a staff recommendation that can be brought to the Board for funding authorization.

eligibility.quote: Community-based organizations in EDCs are eligible to apply for Community Grants.
A flood management project that is part of a habitat project; A public access project that will provide or improve access or recreational amenities that are part of a habitat project.

after_award.quote: At project completion, the grantee submits a final invoice for remaining project costs and withheld amounts along with a final Lessons Learned summary report of the project.
